title: Mark a claim verified only when the source supports it
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads a source document and claim, runs product step `judge` (FixtureJudgeProvider cassette) for: Mark a claim verified only when the source supports it.
